summary: Phase 4 testing completed: Theme toggle (light/dark) works system-wide with localStorage persistence on all pages (login, blocked, authenticated). Live Feed tab on Attack Analysis page displays real-time block events with pause/resume, proper event structure, and working Block functionality. i18n PT/EN translations verified. All features working correctly.
passed_tests: Theme toggle on login page (data-testid=login-theme-toggle) works and persists in localStorage
Theme toggle on blocked public page (data-testid=blocked-theme-toggle) works and persists
Theme toggle in topbar (data-testid=theme-toggle) works and persists across page reloads
Light theme is fully readable: Dashboard charts visible with gridlines, proper text/background contrast, subtle SOC grid pattern
Light theme applies correctly on all pages: Dashboard, Firewall, Logs, Users, Attacks
Attack Analysis page has two tabs: 'Aggregated view' (data-testid=tab-aggregated) and 'Live feed' (data-testid=tab-live-feed)
Live feed tab shows title 'Real-time attack events' with pulsing LIVE indicator

Live feed displays real-time events (43 events found) with proper structure: severity badge, timestamp, internal/external tag, country flag, source IP, hostname, attack type chip, target ip:port, message, Block button
Live feed polls every ~1.5s and updates with new events (framer-motion fade-in animation)
Block button in Live feed opens confirmation dialog with reason field and redirect switch
Confirming block calls /api/attacks/block and shows success toast
Blocked IPs show 'BLOCKED' badge instead of Block button (18 blocked badges found after blocking)
i18n PT/EN: Theme labels translate (Escuro/Claro, Dark/Light)
i18n PT/EN: Tab labels translate (Visão agregada/Aggregated view, Live feed)
i18n PT/EN: Live feed labels translate (AO VIVO/LIVE, Real-time attack events)

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all theme toggle, live feed, i18n, and block functionality tests passed)
